items: Deferred from **Sep 30, 2026 → 1 April 2027** (BCBS framework); 1st revised quarterly disclosure for quarter ending 30 Jun 2027; 10 amendment directions issued for banks/SFBs/payments banks; aligned with ECL framework.

blocks.content: 🧠 Mnemonic → Basel Pillar **3** → deferred to **20*27*** ("3 more" quarters delay)

💼 Interview Q → Why did RBI defer Pillar 3 disclosures? *A: To give banks time to upgrade IT systems, data-reporting and internal controls before mandatory public disclosure of capital adequacy and risk profile.*
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Deferral dates (Sep 30, 2026 → Apr 1, 2027; 1st disclosure Jun 30, 2027).
